acceptanceCriteria: A fixture worker exits within a bounded time after its test binary is SIGKILLed (test that kills a child test process)
Applies to the CAL-V0-127/143 dispatch fixtures
body: Friction from the store-lease-writer lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-store-lease-writer, base 90ab9f33e). Observed on 2026-10-21: two /bin/sh .../TestCALV0143_WorkerLogsAreCappedWhileTheWorkerRuns*/001/host.sh 'work on t1' processes ran with PPID 1 for 1 h and 2 h 55 m after their test binaries were killed. They were killed by PID by the orchestrator. V1-0948 covers cleanup on normal test exit; this case is the test binary itself being killed (timeout or SIGKILL), when t.Cleanup never runs. Expected: fixture workers exit when their parent test process dies, for example by holding a parent pipe and exiting on EOF.

title: Dispatch test workers outlive a SIGKILLed test binary (TestCALV0143 host.sh reparented to init)
